name: Sunset Orchard
description: Sunset Orchard grows Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Apples in 244 Gleaner Chapel Road, RI. The farm is working, and its seasons run through spring, summer, and autumn. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Apr – Jun in this growing zone.
